description: A check reports only an over-budget finding for a running task whose busy session is listed. Read review-pipeline before polling that session, tell the user, and leave the session running.
prompt:
[Scheduled check] chief-of-stuff: check the day
The check printed only:
over budget: Retry backoff running 2h00m (S 30m)
